summary: Preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package advertises itself as a Vue text-input UI component but ships a preinstall lifecycle hook (`setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, unpacks and chmods it executable in a temp directory, and invokes it against a sibling `math_init.js` — a ~727KB obfuscated Bun-compiled bundle. `setup.mjs` itself uses obfuscator.io-style identifier renaming (`_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`,...) and indirect-dispatch tables to hide the download-and-execute flow, and `math_init.js` is a single-line bundle with a rotated string-array (`WV8StW`) consistent with packed/obfuscated code. A Vue input component has no legitimate need for a second language runtime or an opaque compiled binary payload at install time; the pattern matches an alternate-runtime dropper that uses Bun to execute attacker-controlled code out of view of Node-focused scanners on every `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
